"""Conservative target-driven finite-state controller with reacquisition hysteresis."""

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def decide(observation, memory):
    """Gate unsafe motion, verify target identity, then steer with bounded hysteresis."""
    memory = dict(memory or {})
    state = memory.get("state", "IDLE")
    scan_direction = memory.get("scan_direction", "SCAN_LEFT")
    last_turn = memory.get("last_turn", "")
    last_bearing = float(memory.get("last_bearing", 0.0))

    visible = bool(observation["target_visible"])
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    distance = observation["target_distance_class"]
    target_confidence = float(observation["target_confidence"])
    identity_confidence = float(observation["target_identity_confidence"])
    track_age = int(observation["track_age"])
    lost_steps = int(observation["lost_steps"])
    safety_confidence = float(observation["safety_confidence"])
    closing_risk = float(observation["closing_risk"])
    heading_error = abs(float(observation["heading_error"]))

    if safety_confidence < 0.60 or closing_risk >= 0.75:
        memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
        memory["last_turn"] = ""
        return "STOP", 0.99, memory

    confirmed = (
        visible
        and target_confidence >= 0.55
        and identity_confidence >= 0.60
    )
    if not confirmed:
        if state in {"LOCKED", "APPROACH", "VERIFY", "REACQUIRE"} or lost_steps > 0:
            memory["state"] = "REACQUIRE"
            if lost_steps <= 1:
                return "STOP", 0.92, memory
        memory["state"] = "SEARCH"
        memory["scan_direction"] = (
            "SCAN_RIGHT" if scan_direction == "SCAN_LEFT" else "SCAN_LEFT"
        )
        memory["last_turn"] = ""
        return scan_direction, 0.75, memory

    if track_age < 2:
        memory["state"] = "VERIFY"
        return "SLOW_DOWN", 0.80, memory

    memory["last_bearing"] = bearing
    memory["state"] = "LOCKED"

    if distance == "near":
        if heading_error <= 15.0 and identity_confidence >= 0.80:
            memory["state"] = "ARRIVED"
            return "ARRIVED", 0.96, memory
        turn = "VEER_LEFT" if bearing < 0 else "VEER_RIGHT"
        memory["last_turn"] = turn
        memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
        return turn, 0.88, memory

    memory["state"] = "APPROACH"
    left = bool(observation["corridor_left"])
    right = bool(observation["corridor_right"])
    center = bool(observation["corridor_center"])
    magnitude = abs(bearing)

    if bearing < -18.0 and left:
        action = "VEER_LEFT"
    elif bearing > 18.0 and right:
        action = "VEER_RIGHT"
    elif 8.0 <= magnitude <= 18.0:
        # Keep a prior safe turn briefly to prevent left/right chatter.
        prior = last_turn
        if prior == "VEER_LEFT" and left and bearing <= 2.0:
            action = prior
        elif prior == "VEER_RIGHT" and right and bearing >= -2.0:
            action = prior
        elif bearing < 0 and left:
            action = "VEER_LEFT"
        elif bearing > 0 and right:
            action = "VEER_RIGHT"
        elif center and magnitude < 12.0:
            action = "FORWARD"
        else:
            action = "STOP"
    elif center and magnitude < 12.0:
        action = "FORWARD"
    elif bearing < 0 and left:
        action = "VEER_LEFT"
    elif bearing > 0 and right:
        action = "VEER_RIGHT"
    else:
        action = "STOP"

    if action in {"VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT"}:
        memory["last_turn"] = action
        return action, 0.90 if magnitude >= 18.0 else 0.84, memory
    if action == "FORWARD":
        memory["last_turn"] = ""
        return action, 0.90, memory

    memory["state"] = "STOPPED"
    memory["last_turn"] = ""
    return "STOP", 0.98, memory
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
